text: China’s economic policy holds line as growth weakens Mercator Institute for China Studies (MERICS)

title: If you think China needs to dethrone U.S. dollar, you don't understand how it is waging global currency war
title_zh: 如果你认为中国需要推翻美元，那你就不明白它是如何发动全球货币战争的
text: It's misguided to focus on China's renminbi replacing the U.S. dollar. Beijing is already successfully reducing dependence on a dollar-centric global system.
zh: 关注人民币取代美元是错误的。北京已经成功减少了对以美元为中心的全球体系的依赖。

title: America can't get enough of protein. The dairy industry can't keep up
title_zh: 美国无法获得足够的蛋白质。乳制品行业跟不上
text: Demand for whey protein is off the charts as American diet trends change and GLP-1s boom, and the dairy industry is struggling to produce enough.
zh: 随着美国饮食趋势的变化和 GLP-1 的蓬勃发展，乳清蛋白的需求量激增，而乳制品行业却难以生产足够的乳清蛋白。

title: IRAs hold trillions more than 401(k) plans — yet people hardly save in them
title_zh: IRA 持有的资金比 401(k) 计划多出数万亿美元——但人们却很少在其中存钱
text: Investors are increasingly rolling money from 401(k) plans to IRAs. Some observers fear they're exposed to poor investment advice.
zh: 投资者越来越多地将资金从 401(k) 计划转入 IRA。一些观察家担心他们会收到糟糕的投资建议。

title: Some renters say homeownership isn't part of their American Dream: Renting is 'really freeing for me'
title_zh: 一些租房者表示，拥有住房并不是他们美国梦的一部分：租房“对我来说真的是一种自由”
text: Some no longer see renting as a temporary stop on the path to homeownership but rather a long-term lifestyle choice, reflecting a shift in the American Dream.
zh: 一些人不再将租房视为买房道路上的暂时停止，而是一种长期的生活方式选择，反映了美国梦的转变。

title: Here are 3 big things we're watching in the stock market in the week ahead
title_zh: 以下是未来一周我们在股市中关注的三件大事
text: It's jobs week, and Nike has a pivotal earnings report and a long-awaited breakup is complete.
zh: 今天是就业周，耐克发布了关键的盈利报告，期待已久的分拆也已经完成。

title: OpenAI limits new AI models to 'trusted partners' at request of U.S. government
title_zh: 应美国政府要求，OpenAI 将新的人工智能模型限制为“值得信赖的合作伙伴”
text: OpenAI said it previewed the new models' capabilities with the government ahead of the launch.
zh: OpenAI 表示，它在发布前与政府预览了新模型的功能。

title: Treasury Secretary Bessent backs rate cuts but says he understands if the Fed wants to wait
title_zh: 财政部长贝森特支持降息，但表示他理解美联储是否愿意等待
text: Bessent has previously said the Fed should hasten cutting interest rates, calling reductions "the only ingredient missing" for stronger economic growth.
zh: 贝森特此前曾表示，美联储应加快降息，称降息是经济增长强劲的“唯一缺失的因素”。

title: Warren Buffett says he sold Apple too soon and would buy more of it, though not in this market
title_zh: 沃伦·巴菲特表示，他太早卖掉了苹果公司，并将购买更多苹果公司，尽管不是在这个市场
text: Apple remains Berkshire Hathaway's largest holding even after the conglomerate trimmed its stake at the end of last year.
zh: 即使伯克希尔哈撒韦公司去年底减持了其股份，苹果公司仍然是伯克希尔哈撒韦公司最大的持股公司。

title: I had gallbladder surgery. After I got home, the hospital asked me for a financial donation. Is this ethical?
title_zh: 我做了胆囊手术。回家后，医院要求我捐款。这符合道德吗？
text: “The letter asked whether I had a favorite caregiver and if I would like to make a contribution in their honor.”
zh: “这封信询问我是否有最喜欢的看护者，以及我是否愿意为他们的荣誉做出贡献。”

title: Seniors in Medicare are about to get landmark obesity drug coverage — but many may not know it yet
title_zh: 医疗保险中的老年人即将获得具有里程碑意义的肥胖药物承保——但许多人可能还不知道
text: Many seniors may be unaware of the landmark coverage shift starting on July 1, with limited advertising seen from the government or Eli Lilly and Novo.
zh: 许多老年人可能不知道从 7 月 1 日开始的具有里程碑意义的覆盖范围转变，政府或礼来公司 (Eli Lilly) 和 Novo 的广告有限。

title: Top Wall Street analysts are bullish on these 3 stocks for strong long-term growth potential
title_zh: 华尔街顶级分析师看好这三只股票的强劲长期增长潜力
text: Amid volatility in global markets, top analysts can help investors look past near-term noise and pick attractive stocks with long-term potential.
zh: 在全球市场波动的情况下，顶级分析师可以帮助投资者抛开近期噪音，挑选具有长期潜力的有吸引力的股票。

title: Red-alert heatwaves are becoming Europe's new normal. Investors are paying attention
title_zh: 红色警报热浪正在成为欧洲的新常态。投资者正在关注
text: Temperature records were smashed across Europe this week, prompting several countries across the continent to issued high-level warnings about danger to life.
zh: 本周，欧洲各地的气温记录被打破，促使欧洲大陆的几个国家发布了生命危险的高级警告。

title: Small cap-focused Russell 2000 becomes first U.S. benchmark to enter correction territory
title_zh: 以小盘股为主的罗素 2000 指数成为首个进入调整区间的美国基准指数
text: Small caps are especially sensitive to changes in oil prices and a slowdown in the economic cycle.
zh: 小盘股对油价变化和经济周期放缓尤其敏感。

title: Fed still expects to cut rates once this year despite spiking oil prices
title_zh: 尽管油价飙升，美联储仍预计今年降息一次
text: The central bank's so-called dot plot showed a median estimate of 3.4% for the federal funds rate, the same as at the end of last year.
zh: 央行所谓的点阵图显示，联邦基金利率的中值为3.4%，与去年年底相同。

title: Your health insurer shouldn’t decide your treatment plan. That’s what your doctor — and AI — should be doing.
title_zh: 您的健康保险公司不应该决定您的治疗计划。这就是你的医生和人工智能应该做的。
text: With a digital health record, clinicians and AI-driven diagnostic tools would be able to see your full health history, and then make better decisions.
zh: 有了数字健康记录，临床医生和人工智能驱动的诊断工具将能够查看您的完整健康史，然后做出更好的决策。

title: ‘It feels like a medical miracle’: How did a single QR code coupon cut my $618 Walgreens prescription to $15?
title_zh: “感觉就像一个医学奇迹”：一张二维码优惠券如何将我 618 美元的沃尔格林处方药减至 15 美元？
text: “This medication was generic.”
zh: “这种药物是通用的。”

title: Micron is about to be more profitable than any U.S. company except Nvidia and Google
title_zh: 美光科技的盈利能力将超过除英伟达和谷歌之外的任何美国公司
text: Big Tech companies are willing to pay astronomical prices for AI memory components, helping spark a dramatic turnaround in Micron’s finances.
zh: 大型科技公司愿意为人工智能内存组件支付天文数字的价格，帮助美光科技的财务状况发生了巨大的转变。

title: Forget the ‘Sell America’ trade: Why U.S. markets keep proving the naysayers wrong
title_zh: 忘记“推销美国”贸易：为什么美国市场不断证明反对者是错误的
text: Foreign investors are still pouring money into U.S. assets, and the dollar remains the undisputed global reserve currency.
zh: 外国投资者仍在向美国资产注入资金，美元仍然是无可争议的全球储备货币。

title: How to work in retirement without seeing your Social Security checks slashed
title_zh: 如何在退休后工作而不会看到社会保障支票被削减
text: Claiming benefits before full retirement age while keeping a job can trigger unexpected withholdings — but the money isn’t lost forever.
zh: 在完全退休年龄之前领取福利并同时保住工作可能会引发意外的扣缴，但这笔钱不会永远丢失。

title: Americans’ 401(k) balances hit record levels last year. See how you compare.
title_zh: 去年美国人的 401(k) 余额创下历史新高。看你比较如何。
text: It was a very good year for most workplace retirement savers, according to Vanguard’s latest “How America Saves” report.
zh: 根据先锋集团最新的《美国如何储蓄》报告，对于大多数职场退休储蓄者来说，今年是非常好的一年。

title: Social Security says I was overpaid for 7 years. I believe it’s mistaken. Can they cut my benefits?
title_zh: 社会保障局说我多付了七年的工资。我相信这是错误的。他们可以削减我的福利吗？
text: “They say I made $43,000 in 2019, but I actually made that in 2020.”
zh: “他们说我 2019 年赚了 43,000 美元，但实际上我是 2020 年赚的。”

title: This disease is more expensive than cancer and heart disease combined. And it’s only going to get worse.
title_zh: 这种疾病的治疗费用比癌症和心脏病的总和还要高。而且情况只会变得更糟。
text: “People should be alarmed. This is a health crisis. It’s also an economic crisis for families and government.”
zh: “人们应该保持警惕。这是一场健康危机。对于家庭和政府来说，这也是一场经济危机。”

text: How the attack on Iran could impact the global oil market and economy CNBC
zh: 对伊朗的袭击可能如何影响全球石油市场和经济 CNBC

title: A 'perfect storm' points to a much smaller U.S. auto market by 2040
title_zh: “完美风暴”表明美国汽车市场到 2040 年将大幅缩小
text: The auto industry is selling fewer cars--one forecaster says this is a fundamental change, and it is going to get worse.
zh: 汽车行业的汽车销量正在减少——一位预测人士表示，这是一个根本性的变化，而且情况还会变得更糟。

title: From concerts to train rides, bots are winning the ticket wars — but they're only part of the problem
title_zh: 从音乐会到火车旅行，机器人正在赢得门票大战——但这只是问题的一部分
text: From concerts to train reservations, automated bots have become the latest target in the fight against ticket scalping.
zh: 从音乐会到火车预订，自动化机器人已成为打击倒票行为的最新目标。

title: OpenAI hasn't held pre-IPO investor meetings or set timeline yet, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，OpenAI 尚未召开 IPO 前投资者会议或设定时间表
text: OpenAI said it confidentially filed its prospectus with the SEC earlier this month, but noted it "may be a while" before it goes public.
zh: OpenAI 表示，该公司本月早些时候向 SEC 秘密提交了招股说明书，但指出“可能需要一段时间”才能上市。

title: Trump eases pressure on Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh as inflation tops 4%
title_zh: 通胀率突破4%，特朗普缓解了对美联储主席凯文·沃什的压力
text: President Donald Trump's economic advisors are giving Warsh space, as the new Fed chairman, on interest rates as the president repeats calls to cut.
zh: 在总统再次呼吁降息之际，唐纳德·特朗普总统的经济顾问正在为新任美联储主席沃什在利率问题上给予空间。

title: Jeremy Grantham says, 'This is the most expensive market in American history'
title_zh: 杰里米格兰瑟姆说：“这是美国历史上最昂贵的市场”
text: Jeremy Grantham says soaring valuations around AI makes the U.S. stock market historically expensive.
zh: 杰里米·格兰瑟姆 (Jeremy Grantham) 表示，围绕人工智能的估值飙升，使美国股市处于历史高位。

title: Berkshire shares trade lower even after Abel scores good marks at meeting, earnings jump
title_zh: 即使阿贝尔在会议上取得好成绩、盈利大幅增长，伯克希尔股价仍走低
text: Many in the investment community were reassured by Abel's firm grasp over Berkshire's sprawling enterprise.
zh: 阿贝尔对伯克希尔庞大企业的坚定控制让投资界的许多人感到放心。

title: ‘She is retired’: Do I dip into my 401(k) to pay my mother’s $30,000 credit-card debt?
title_zh: “她退休了”：我是否需要动用 401(k) 来偿还我母亲 30,000 美元的信用卡债务？
text: “I want her to live on her Social Security instead of using it to pay off her credit-card debt.”
zh: “我希望她靠社会保障生活，而不是用它来偿还信用卡债务。”

title: ‘I’ll happily wait’: Does delaying Social Security make sense for high earners like me?
title_zh: “我会很乐意等待”：延迟社会保障对于像我这样的高收入者有意义吗？
text: “In many states, Social Security benefits are exempt from state income tax.”
zh: “在许多州，社会保障福利免征州所得税。”
